input_text: On the issue of whether Carl had knowledge of Amy's intentions, Carl told the questioning attorney on redirect examination that he knew Amy's intentions.

claim.text: Is the statement described in this narrative hearsay under FRE 801(c)?

arguments.text: The statement was made during Carl's redirect examination in court, not out of court.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) requires a hearsay statement to be made out of court.
arguments.evidence_span: Carl told the questioning attorney on redirect examination

arguments.text: The statement contains an explicit assertion that Carl knew Amy's intentions.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) requires the statement to be an assertion.

arguments.text: The statement is offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted, specifically Carl's knowledge of Amy's intentions.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) requires the statement to be offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted.
arguments.evidence_span: On the issue of whether Carl had knowledge of Amy's intentions, Carl told... that he knew Amy's intentions.

arguments.text: Because the statement was made in court, it fails the foundational requirement of FRE 801(c) that hearsay must be an out-of-court statement.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) definition of hearsay excludes in-court testimony.
